subject.title: Codex dynamic tools should normalize raw plugin payloads

question: Which open raw-payload normalization PR should be the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-reproducible, but two open PRs target the same bridge boundary and automation should not create a third fix or pick a branch without maintainer review.

options.title: Consolidate on one linked PR
options.body: Review and land either https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97917 after proof/CI requirements are satisfied, then close the other as superseded.

options.title: Request a replacement branch
options.body: Close or pause both candidate PRs only if maintainers want a different normalizer shape or proof package than either branch provides.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on one linked PR
recommendation.body: Review and land either https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97917 after proof/CI requirements are satisfied, then close the other as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has recent merged history in the Codex dynamic-tool and middleware-output boundary that this issue affects.
